role: The static registry of all 33 vanilla achievements, each with its parent, grid position and icon, plus the GUI bounds and the achievementList.
scope_reason: The parent chain decides which awards count and the list drives the login S37 (StatisticsFile.func_150884_b).

members.name: openInventory..bookcase, field_150962_H..field_150961_L
members.note: parents, names, descriptions and icons for all 33

members.name: onARail

members.name: flyPig
members.note: EntityPig.fall with a player rider past 5 blocks (riding.c:ride_pig_fly, lane/ride); idx-flypig-s1 starts from the stats-s1 checkpoint (killCow, its parent, unlocked), saddles a pig, mounts it and drops it ten blocks: the award and pigOneCm match the oracle's stats dump.
